chunks: I have not created the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of creation for jinn and humans according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is interpreted not merely as a command for ritual acts, but as the ontological purpose of creation, encompassing both 'ubudiyyah (servitude) and ma'rifah (gnosis) of the Divine. It establishes that the existence of jinn and humans is intrinsically linked to recognizing and worshipping Allah, a concept further elaborated in the hadith of Mi'raj where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is told that the purpose of his prophethood is to perfect this worship. This verse thus serves as the foundational axiom for understanding the teleology of human life within the Islamic worldview.
